claims.statement: Tom Allen was an English boxer of science and renown.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen,an English boxer of science and senown

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss in Kentucky, and referee Eph Holland, said to be fixed, declared Goss the winner on a foul.
claims.excerpt: he declared Goss the winner on a foul

claims.statement: A sheriff and his deputies broke up the Allen-Goss fight, and the fighters fled to an adjoining county.
claims.excerpt: a sheriff and his squad of deputies swooped down

claims.statement: Referee Eph Holland of Boston was said to have been fixed to give Goss the decision.
claims.excerpt: was fixed to give Goss the cecision, and he declared Goss

claims.statement: Fred Watkins, Allen's backer, was said to have lost $1,000 to referee Eph Holland at the Goss fight.
claims.excerpt: to the tune of $1,000 by Holland

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Mike McCool, and the referee afterward called a foul against Allen.
claims.excerpt: Allen also met big Mike McCool, a burly Irishman

fights.excerpt: he declared Goss the winner on a foul
fights.notes: Paper says Allen had beaten Goss almost blind before the foul result; referee Eph Holland said to be fixed. Result is as the paper reports the referee's decision.

fights.excerpt: Allen also met big Mike McCool, a burly Irishman
fights.notes: Text garbled. Paper says a foul was called against Allen and that McCool later acknowledged he was fairly beaten; the result is uncertain.

notes: Retrospective account from 1896; the 'robbed' framing is the paper's. Dates are approximate, from 'ten years later' than the early 1860s.
